name: Regno di Candia
notes: Generalized territorial extent clipped to Natural Earth land. Start 1211 per the O'Connell appendix and the 1211 Concessio Insulae Cretensis (p172 n14); anchors date the surrender of Candia at year level 1669 and the day-level end is retained.

name: Corfu
notes: Initial protection phase before direct rule; boundary-year touch is intentional. Both anchors model a single 1386-1797 phase; the split is editorial per decision D10.

name: Corfu
notes: Generalized territorial extent clipped to Natural Earth land. End day verified - the Great Council voted itself out of existence on May 12 1797 (Lane p436).

name: Venetian Dalmatia
notes: Consolidation phase after the purchase of Dalmatian rights; municipal autonomy retained per decision D10. Start day verified - the treaty with Ladislas was signed in San Silvestro on July 9 1409 (O'Connell p28).

name: Venetian Dalmatia
notes: Generalized coastal extent; rule status does not erase commune autonomy per decision D10. Spalato and Trau confirmed July 1420 with Curzola September and Brazza October; Lesina followed March 1421 (O'Connell p30).

name: Negroponte
notes: Venetian jurisdiction within the divided feudal island; tripartite simplification documented in decision D10. Start corrected from 1209 to 1211 - the bailo was elected regularly from 1211 (O'Connell p164 n r); the 1209 terzieri-treaty date is outside the anchor sources.

name: Negroponte
notes: Full-sovereignty phase ending with the Ottoman conquest. Island in Ottoman hands by July 1470 (O'Connell p35); renounced by the treaty of January 25 1479 (Lane p236).

name: Venetian Morea
notes: Three disjoint fortress envelopes cover Modon Coron and Nauplia/Argos; not continuous peninsular rule per D10. Start corrected from 1207 to 1206 - the fleet took possession of Modon and Coron in 1206 (O'Connell p19); Lane dates the award to the 1204 partition (p242).

name: Kingdom of the Morea
notes: De-facto conquest-to-loss window; distinct from treaty recognition 1699–1718 per decision D10. Anchors are year-level - Morosini's conquest ran 1684-1688 and the Ottoman reconquest opened in 1714 (Lane pp410-411); O'Connell does not cover this phase.

name: Kingdom of Cyprus
notes: Venetian kingdom phase. Standard of San Marco raised February 1489 with formal submission June 20 (O'Connell p37); Famagusta fell before Lepanto was fought on October 7 1571 (Lane p372); O'Connell's narrative dates the Ottoman taking 1570 (p38) - variant recorded in the ledger.

name: Albania Veneta
notes: Generalized coastal holdings around the southern Adriatic. Durazzo inherited 1392 and Dulcigno held to 1571 per the O'Connell appendix; Scutari was already surrendered by the January 25 1479 treaty (Lane p236) - envelope per decision D10.
